actions.create_chatbot.description: Create a new chatbot using a template or from scratch.
actions.create_chatbot.props.template_id: Use a template to create the chatbot
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.send_message.description: Send a message to the chatbot and receive an AI response.
actions.send_message.props.ai_model_id.d: Select the AI model to use
actions.send_message.props.contact_id.de: Associate the conversation with a contact
Additional instructions to tailor the AI response
actions.send_message.props.language_id.d: Select the language for the AI response
actions.send_message.props.message.descr: The message to send to the AI
actions.send_message.props.temperature.d: Controls randomness (0 = focused, 1 = creative). Default is 0.
auth.description:
To obtain your API key:

1. Go to your [Chatling account](https://app.chatling.ai)
2. Open **Project Settings**
3. Click the **API Keys** tab
4. Press **New API key** and generate a new key
5. Copy the key (it's only shown once)
description: Build AI chatbots trained on your data.

triggers.new_conversation.description: Triggers when a new conversation is started by a customer.
